mapper.select: select rs.id, rs.update_time, rs.platform_type, rs.sku_id, rs.sku_no, rs.country, rs.shop_id, rs.platform, rs.replenishment_type, rs.remark, rsd.id as detailId, rsd.sku_type, rsd.fba_usable_qty, rsd.fba_in_transit_qty, rsd.fba_plan_delivery_qty, rsd.overseas_usable_qty, rsd.overseas_in_transit_qty, rsd.overseas_plan_delivery_qty, rsd.local_usable_qty, rsd.local_in_transit_qty, rsd.local_plan_purchase_qty, rsd.total_inventory_qty, rsd.sales_qty as salesQtyJson, rsd.avg_sales_qty as avgSalesQtyJson, rsd.sales_estimate_qty as salesEstimateQtyJson, rsd.avg_sales_estimate_qty as avgSalesEstimateQtyJson, rsd.purchase_approve_days, rsd.production_days, rsd.supplier_delivery_days, rsd.qc_days, rsd.purchase_cycle_days, rsd.safe_days, rsd.instock_days, rsd.fba_sellable_days, rsd.overseas_sellable_days, rsd.local_sellable_days, rsd.total_sellable_days, rsd.delivery_min_days, rsd.delivery_default_days, rsd.delivery_max_days, rsd.logistics_cycle_days, rsd.logistics_min_cycle_days, rsd.logistics_max_cycle_days, rsd.stock_up_min_days, rsd.stock_up_default_days, rsd.stock_up_max_days, rsd.cfg_fba_in_transit from replenishment_suggestion rs inner join replenishment_suggestion_detail rsd on rs.id = rsd.main_id and rsd.is_deleted = false where rsd.id = #{detailId}

SELECT rs.shop_id AS shopId, COALESCE ( ( SELECT si.original_sales_qty FROM sales_info AS si WHERE si.is_deleted = FALSE AND rsd.id = si.replenishment_detail_id AND si.original_sales_qty != 0 ORDER BY si.date DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0 ) AS qty FROM replenishment_suggestion AS rs INNER JOIN replenishment_suggestion_detail AS rsd ON rsd.is_deleted = FALSE AND rsd.main_id = rs.id WHERE rs.sku_id = #{skuId} AND rs.shop_id in
#{shopId}
